homeMasksHeader:
It is a paradigm shift
in art collecting
homeMasksDesc1: We would like to introduce you to CosmoMasks, a collaborative project created by more than 50 artists. The authors of the project were so inspired by the idea of discovering new galaxies and the search for extraterrestrial life that they even placed elements of unknown space technologies of the future on their NFT. The most important part of the completion of these artworks is the naming of the 16,410 unique characters in the collection by the owners. That is where you can make your contribution. Inspired by space exploration, we took another step forward. Our goal is to make the artwork purchaser its co-author.
homeMasksDesc2: Each owner has the opportunity to contribute to the process by giving the desired name to the artwork he / she owns, using the CMP (CosmoMasks Power). Years later, the ability to rename individual NFT becomes expensive, as the release of new CMP stops. One day the name change becomes absolutely impossible. At that point, the NFT will be fully completed. The final touch will be done by its owner.
homeMasksDesc3: CosmoMasks blurs the line when an art connoisseur could only agree with the extraordinary vision of the author. More than 50 artists from around the world have collaborated to create this collection of 16,410 unique characters, but these artworks are not finished yet. Unlike traditional art, the torch is passed to you. You get the privilege of adding your unique touch.
homeMask1Desc: The rising price of digital art for collectibles
homeMask2Desc: Created by more than 50 artists and inspired by the space conquest
homeMask3Desc: Random, fair distribution in the initial purchase
homeMask4Desc: Full ownership and unrestricted rights to commercial use granted to the consumer for their NFT
homeMask5Desc: Naming becomes scarce due to CMP token mechanism
homeFinal10NftHeader:
10 collectible NFTs
for true connoisseurs of art
homeFinal10NftDescPart1: The final 10 NFTs in the collection will be the most valuable and will not be mixed with the remaining 16,400 NFTs. They will be available for sale only after all 16,400 NFTs have been purchased.
homeFinal10NftDescPart2: All 10 NFTs are inhabitants of other galaxies, which are connected with each other by a golden thread - a symbol that passes through each character, as a path, energy, something that can unite everyone.
homeHowDoesItWorkDescPart1: There are 16,410 unique NFTs in total. Each of them is a combination of different artists’ artworks. They have different masks, eye colors, objects, and other attributes. It means that all CosmoMasks are unique, but some are even rarer than others.
homeHowDoesItWorkDescPart2: To ensure a fair distribution, the purchaser will not know which NFT he / she is buying for the first 14 days from the date of sale. All NFTs have been created already, but not indexed. There is a predefined sequence of NFTs. Which one is the first will only be known at the end of the sale due to randomized algorithms. This method guarantees a fair distribution. We decided to limit the sale maximum to 20 NFTs per transaction due to the expected high demand in the initial distribution period.
homeHowDoesItWorkDescPart3: The initial sale period will start at 4 p.m. on March 14, 2021 (CEST).
homeHowDoesItWorkDescPart4: CosmoMasks will be sold according to the schedule given below (price reduction is possible as described in the FAQ). After 14 days or after all the NFTs are sold (whichever comes first), the deposit period ends. Your NFTs will be opened.
homeHowDoesItWorkDescPart5: If the NFTs are not sold after the disclosure phase, the sale will continue at the prevailing rate with two major changes: (1) all portraits will be shown, so you will know which one you are buying and (2) there won't be a bonus CMP for first 14 days.
homeAnImmortalWorkOfArtDescPart1: You do not just buy a rare piece of art. You become a part of it. Smart contracts allow you to name your NFT, and add your unique touch to it. Thus, you become one of the co-authors who turn this raw canvas into an immortal piece of art. Your NFT can serve as your digital identity as we move towards a fully digital economy.
homeMaskPowerIntroductionDescPart1: Every day, each picture accumulates 10 CosmoMasks Power (CMP) that can be claimed by the current owner. Once you have 1,830 CMP you can burn these tokens and change the name of your CosmoMasks in the blockchain. Smart contracts require each name to be unique, which creates a second level of scarcity in the artwork. In exactly 10 years from now, on March 14, 2031, the last CMP will be released. From that moment the stock will only decrease until the last CMP token is burned and the artwork is completed.
homeMaskPowerIntroductionDescPart2: Any participant within the first 14 days of the initial purchase period will receive a CMP for 1 year (3,660 CMP, equivalent to 2 name changes). After 14 days, each NFT starts with enough resources for one name change (1,830 CMP).
What is it #1: The CosmoMasks Power (CMP) is the native token of the CosmoMasks artwork. The CMP serves only a single purpose: It allows its holder to give his / her CosmoMask a unique name that is permanently stored and publicly visible on the Ethereum Blockchain. Thus, it commoditizes the name itself and makes it the rarest of all attributes within the entire project. This opens up a whole new dimension for collectiblewhere the preferences of the consumers highly impact upon a value hierarchy of the individual pieces of the whole collective art.
What is it #2: If you own a CosmoMask, you can claim the CMPs accumulated by the NFT. Each NFT accumulates around 3,660 CMPs per year. If you participate in the initial contribution period, you receive an additional 1,830 CMPs. To change the name of an NFT, you need to burn 1,830 CMPs (about ½ years of NFT emission).
The Rules #1: There should be no identical names.
The Rules #2: There is a limit of 25 symbols (including spaces).
The Rules #3: Uniqueness is case insensitive (i.e. «John» and «john» are considered the same for the blockchain).
The Rules #4: There are no leading or trailing «spaces».
The Rules #5: Only alphanumerical symbols are eligible for use.
The Rules #6: Used names become available immediately after the name of the CosmoMask was changed.
Emission Rate of PowerToken Desc: Each year, approximately 3,660 CMPs will be accumulated by each CosmoMask. You need 1,830 CMPs to change the name of your CosmoMask. To give more deciding power over early participants, each participant in the first distribution period (14 days) will receive an additional 1,830 CMPs. After 10 years, the emission of new CMPs comes to a halt. From then on, CMPs can only be burnt until one day no CMPs are left and the names of the CosmoMasks cannot be altered anymore. The artwork is then considered complete.
